verdict.rationale: GitHub's first-party docs describe connecting MCP servers to Copilot Chat to pull in context from other applications. They also show Copilot Chat in the IDE using the GitHub MCP server, configured remotely or locally in VS Code, to work with repositories, issues and PRs, so the MCP-client capability is documented. missing for 10: detail on how arbitrary third-party MCP tools are invoked and configured, evidence of MCP support in Copilot cloud agent or Copilot CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
